recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No current FHIR source correction is needed unless the work group reopens the broader canonical-versus-literal URL policy.
issue_request: FHIR-5381 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 Vocabulary ballot comment on the ValueSet page. It objected that wording describing a value set location as a URL, often relative to the same server, implied that a resource or profile specifying a value set depended on the implementation path.
initial_application: No git commit explicitly mentions FHIR-5381. The old DSTU-era wording was added in ab6d7c95d1 before the issue was filed and later replaced in 1120eb61d0 with a ValueSet Identification section that separates local id/location from canonical URL. A later canonical URL cleanup in 6f7c3716ef8 preserved and clarified that distinction.
additional_context: ValueSet is active in source/fhir.ini. The current introduction says ValueSet.id/local location changes across servers, ValueSet.url is the canonical URL that never changes, and most references use the canonical URL. The current ValueSet.url definition also says it SHALL remain the same when stored on different servers. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current build-scope source already resolves the path-dependence concern and the exact old wording is absent from current source.
